verdicts.reason: The heavy base is built on untreated marsh and ordinary jobs finish without the branch routes. This is the stated red failure.
Mud holds by weight, the stuck pawn takes no injury, self-release works and a companion pulls another pawn free.
The trunk never changes after excavation and the borer opens no visible gallery. This matches the red failure.
Reach grows with pool size, and large-pool encounter eligibility is checked separately rather than inferred from reach.
A real seizure leaves the colonist alive under a deadline. Nearby carrying clears the deadline, and distant help is not guaranteed.
One attack removes treasure service at every pool and changes no local danger. This is the red failure.
The sound resumes while a second hush still holds it and ignores the living bird population.
The list comes through a supported supply lane and shows an independent dated snapshot. Reading leaves danger unchanged.
Whole-body emergence occurs as a routine ambient event, but it must stay excluded from ambient play as plot-reserved material.
Treatment disabled in transit is returned intact, and the defeated adult agrees with the shared Tenant by making no strikes.
The tank teaches on failed placement and a fatal hit silently deletes the captive. Both are red failures.
The young establishes over several days without immediate revival. Wrong-pool poison fails, and the right poison at its own pool stops it.
A repeated display release pays the reward twice. This is the stated red failure.
Normal bait work produces a delayed two-front wager from separate edges. Raiders keep converging on the bait while it is available.
The alarm never changes the intruder retreat route, which the contract requires to be altered.
The ambusher pursues escaping prey across the map, violating its ambush contract, even though drinking is correct.
A real harvest yields product, and a real spark flashes eligible haze without waking the permanently defeated adult.
A normal lure raid steals a colonist, but theft must stay absent. This is the red failure.
Reload cancels the active rescue deadline, so the obligation is forgiven instead of surviving the mid-consequence save.
Poison at disconnected pool B stops A's establishment, but only the right poison at that particular pool may do so.
Reading raises pool A's actual agitation and strike chance. The list must not edit danger, and its snapshot is not independent.
Ambience and calls resume while the sentinel hush is still active, but neither may resume until all hush reasons end.
Disabling the feature in transit consumes the treatment charges instead of returning them.
The second front enters beside the first even though a separate reachable approach exists. This is the red failure.
The grievance stops porters at both pools and raises no danger at A, but it belongs to the attacked pool and must raise its danger.
Weight-scaled mud holds the heavy pawn without injury and allows self-escape, while the light pawn crosses freely.
